content.title: Got two offers?
content.subtitle: Don't decide on the name and ranking alone.

steps.title: Total cost
steps.detail: Tuition plus rent, food and travel. Work it out for the whole course.

steps.title: Scholarship or funding
steps.detail: How much help does each offer give? Subtract it from the cost.

steps.title: Course modules
steps.detail: Where are the subjects you want? Put both syllabuses side by side.

steps.title: City and living
steps.detail: Weather, rent and the vibe of the place. Talk to seniors who live there.

steps.title: Deposit deadline
steps.detail: By when must you confirm each offer? Don't let one expire by mistake.
steps.tip: Make a simple table: offer, cost, funding, deadline.

caption:
Got more than one offer? Congratulations! Now compare them like this 👇

1. Total cost
2. Scholarship or funding
3. Course modules
4. City and living
5. Deposit deadline

Save it 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
